name: WinCarts
author: suryatejatammana

sections.description:
WinCarts helps WooCommerce store owners recover abandoned carts through AI-powered SMS marketing automation. When customers leave items in their cart without completing purchase, our 2-way AI automatically engages with abandoners, resolves their hesitations, and gets more of those carts to checkout without you lifting a finger.

Why choose WinCarts?

  • Effortless setup – Onboard in 5 minutes, secure your toll-free number, and start your cart recovery process fast.
  • Collect Mobile Numbers – Capture phone numbers via exit-intent popups or during checkout, building your SMS audience automatically for your marketing automation strategy.
  • Engage with 2-way AI SMS – Customers get real answers to their questions, not just abandoned cart reminders.
  • Compliant Messaging – SMS sent only with consent, during appropriate hours, with opt-out included.
  • Track every recovered sale – See real ROI in your dashboard, with full attribution for your WooCommerce cart recovery efforts.
  • Win back lost sales automatically – Recover up to 25% of abandoned carts with no manual follow-ups through intelligent SMS marketing automation.

Get started with WinCarts now

Installation

  1. Install and activate the plugin
  2. Connect to your WinCarts Dashboard with your API key
  3. The plugin automatically tracks carts and collects SMS consent
  4. WinCarts Dashboard handles the AI-powered recovery messages

Requirements

  • WooCommerce 5.0 or higher
  • A WinCarts Dashboard account (get one at wincarts.com)
  • SSL certificate recommended for secure data transmission

External Services

This plugin connects to the WinCarts API to provide cart recovery functionality. The connection to this external service is required for the plugin to function.

What the service is used for

The WinCarts API (https://app.wincarts.com) handles:
* Storing and tracking abandoned cart data
* Sending SMS cart recovery messages to customers who have consented
* Managing popup settings and customization

What data is sent and when

  • Cart data: When a customer adds items to their cart, the cart contents (products, quantities, values) and session ID are sent to track the cart.
  • Customer contact information: When a customer provides SMS consent (via checkout checkbox or exit intent popup), their phone number, name, email, timezone, and consent timestamp are sent.
  • Store credentials: During initial setup, WooCommerce API keys are securely transmitted to enable order synchronization.

Data is only sent when:
1. The store owner has connected their WinCarts account
2. Customers have provided explicit SMS consent (for contact information)

Service Terms and Privacy

  • WinCarts Terms of Service: https://www.wincarts.com/terms
  • WinCarts Privacy Policy: https://www.wincarts.com/privacy
sections.faq:
Do I need a WinCarts account?

Yes, you need a WinCarts Dashboard account to use this plugin. The plugin syncs cart data with the dashboard, which handles the AI messaging and SMS delivery.

Is this TCPA compliant?

Yes. The plugin includes proper SMS consent collection with required disclosures. Customers must explicitly opt-in before receiving any messages.

Does it work with WooCommerce Blocks checkout?

Yes, WinCarts fully supports both the classic WooCommerce checkout and the new block-based checkout (WooCommerce 8.7+).

What data is sent to WinCarts?

Cart contents, customer contact information (with consent), and order status. All data is transmitted securely and used only for cart recovery purposes.
